instruction:
Courtyard Hotel Retrofit With Revit Plan Sheet PDF And Room Schedule CSV

This task starts from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc and uses the local reference image C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_sheet.png. In Revit, modify the starting model into a courtyard hotel scheme, export the model as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, export a Revit room area schedule as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv, and export a one-page Revit plan sheet as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf in the Desktop.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv; C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc is at least 500 bytes, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf is at least 200 bytes, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv is at least 20 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities, 17 IfcSpace entities, 24 IfcWall entities, and 6 IfcSlab entities.
5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcDoor, 0 IfcWindow, 0 IfcCurtainWall, 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, 0 IfcStair, 0 IfcColumn, and 0 IfcBeam entities.
6. The normalized IfcSpace name list contains the token bedroom at least 16 times and lounge at least once.
7. The normalized IfcSpace name list contains the exact space name shared lounge at least once.
8. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv is a Revit room schedule export with exactly the headers room name,area in that order and exactly 17 non-empty data rows.
9. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv contains a row Shared Lounge,60 and exactly 16 bedroom rows with area 24 each.
10. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf contains exactly 1 page exported from a Revit sheet.
11. The extracted text from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf contains the case-insensitive tokens COURTYARD HOTEL PLAN and A201.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
